title: A member who pays the gym straight by UPI cannot tell the gym, and the fee keeps showing as owed
what: Pay your gym shows the gym's UPI QR and a Pay by UPI app button. When the member pays that way, the app only says the gym saves the receipt after they pay. There is no I have paid button and no place for the payment reference, and the app re-checks only payments made through a payment company. So the fee stays on screen as open with the pay buttons until someone at the desk spots the money in the bank and records it. The member may pay again or have to go to the desk to prove it.
expected: After a UPI payment the member can tap I have paid (optionally with the reference), the fee shows as waiting for the gym, and the desk is told to check it.
who: members who pay fees by UPI in the app, and the front desk
how_often: every direct UPI payment from the app
fix_line: Add an I have paid step that marks the fee as waiting and alerts the desk to check the bank

title: The member help says renewals are paid at the desk, while the app can show Pay your gym
what: The member help answer for membership says you pay at the desk after asking to renew. The app's membership page can show a Pay your gym box with a UPI QR and a UPI app button for fees the desk asked for. No member help answer explains paying the gym from the app.
expected: The member help says that fees can also be paid from the app when the gym allows it, and what happens after paying.
how_often: whenever a member reads help about renewing at a gym that takes app payments
fix_line: Add a member help answer for Pay your gym and change the renew line to match
